{"toolsets":{"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset":{"name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Graph DSL tools for Blueprint assets.","tools":[{"description":"Transactionally applies a DSL document and returns its canonical form and a new revision. A
failure leaves the asset unchanged.

Use Write for a complete document or a large structural change. Use Edit for a targeted
change that can be expressed as exact replacements against text you just read.

Top-level entries use upsert semantics: omitted entries remain and produce a warning. Delete an
entry with a tombstone such as (event `Foo` :!delete). Deleting a missing entry only warns.

Dsl is omitted when bDslOmitted is true because the submitted document is already canonical.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.Write","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Returns one node type's schema as a DSL form. Query unfamiliar node types before writing:

  (node `Type`
    (in (`Pin` Type) ...)              ; data input pins
    (out (`Pin` Type) ...)             ; data output pins
    (params (`Prop` Type [:over]) ...) ; writable properties, baked as :`Prop` value
    (determines `Prop` ...))           ; properties whose value changes the pin set

(Enum A B ...) lists writable values. :over marks a property with an override input, supplied
as :`Prop` (wire Source). Write an (Instanced /Script/Pkg.Base) property with a concrete
class-headed value: (class:/Script/Pkg.Concrete :`Field` value ...). Empty sections are omitted.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.Schema","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Reads a Blueprint scope as canonical DSL and returns the revision required by Edit.

Scope is empty for the whole asset, GraphName for one graph, or GraphName/EntryName for one
entry. Backtick-quote a segment containing spaces, syntax characters, or `/`; `` `A/B` `` is
one segment. Set bIncludePositions only when node positions are needed.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.Read","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Returns Graph DSL node references whose palette name, category or reference contains the query
(case and spaces ignored), with each one's palette category and name. The reference, not the
palette name, is what goes in a Write or Edit call head.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.FindNodeReferences","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Applies ordered exact replacements to the latest session text. Revision must come from the
latest Read, Write, or Edit for the same asset and scope; otherwise call Read again.

The full batch is staged before mutation. The edit fails without a matching session, with a
stale Revision, when an OldString is absent or non-unique unless bReplaceAll is true, or when
the resulting DSL does not parse. Any failure leaves the asset unchanged.

When bDslOmitted is true, apply the replacements to your existing copy. Otherwise Dsl is the
authoritative canonical text for later edits.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.Edit","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Returns the common grammar followed by the Blueprint dialect reference. Read it before the
first Write or Edit.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.Docs","annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Returns a line diff between two Blueprints' graphs, as DSL, and their class defaults. Empty
when they match.","name":"BlueprintToolsets.BlueprintDslToolset.Diff","annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}}]}},"errors":{}}
